name: Projected Maximal Degree of the Three-Code Class
proof: On the projection $\{x_0,x_1\}$, the trace $01$ is adjacent to both $00$ and $11$, so projected maximal degree is at least two. A three-concept projection has no degree above two. Thus the value is two, as checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_properness\_separation.py}$.
